segments.title: Cold Open & Rennerton Status Report
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour sign-on; Case reports that Mayor Melody Von Torture holds office while Crum refuses to relinquish his general-management post, previews a full broadcast of Rennerton rebuilding, and works through proximity-chat and segment-alert housekeeping.

segments.title: Rebuild Rennerton: Press Corps & Crypt Run
segments.notes: Crum takes over as self-appointed press secretary and press-conference proxy for the mayor, fields the Hungry Press Corps, then raids crypts for bronze cores while fending off the undead to fund a jet-ski program.

segments.title: Rebuild Rennerton: Jet Ski Fleet & Mayoral Election
segments.notes: Crum assembles a jet-ski fleet, reopens and re-drains the swamp portal, and a chat-run election unseats the incumbent in favor of a new mayor.

segments.title: Rebuild Rennerton: Mayor Pepito's Term
segments.notes: Newly elected Mayor Pepito takes the podium, pilots Crum's corpse, and directs construction of a strip club with a functional support pole, VIP table, and lunch buffet.

segments.title: Rebuild Rennerton: Armament & Boss Hunt
segments.notes: Per chat mandate the crew sets fires, crafts a bronze rifle, builds a boat navy, sails to a distant island, and finally fells a giant forest boss with a magic hammer.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Wrap-Up
segments.notes: Pepito takes final press questions beside a bonfire, thanks the rebuild crew, previews the next rebuild and a fresh mayoral election, and signs off.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Executive producer who signed on the broadcast, won the Rennerton mayoral election, and piloted Crum's corpse to build a strip club.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Lead anchor who opened the broadcast with a Rennerton status report before handing gameplay over to Crum.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: Ousted Rennerton mayor turned press secretary who led the jet-ski construction and died repeatedly in the wilderness.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: In-studio contributor and gaming partner who made a brief cameo in the Rennerton woods.

storylines.beat: [10:17] Crum, voted out as mayor, returned as self-appointed press secretary and Vice Mayor under Mayor Melody Von Torture and launched a jet-ski construction program.
[01:18:01] Chat elected Pepito the dog as Mayor of Rennerton, unseating incumbent Melody Von Torture.
[03:40:31] The rebuild crew felled a giant forest boss to close out the session.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito was elected Mayor of Rennerton by chat vote, unseating incumbent Melody Von Torture.
As mayor, Pepito commandeered the repeatedly-killed Crum's corpse ("basically undead now") to build a strip club and set the wilderness on fire.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News turned its Saturday broadcast over to the reconstruction of Rennerton, where ousted mayor Crum staged a press conference on behalf of Mayor Melody Von Torture and launched a jet-ski building program. Chat then elected Executive Producer Pepito the dog as mayor, and he promptly commandeered Crum's repeatedly-deceased body to raise a strip club and set the wilderness ablaze. The crew closed the session by felling a giant forest boss before signing off.
